verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own marketing says a business account can be opened "In Minutes," which would beat a one-week timeline. However, this is only a headline claim, with no detail on verification/approval timelines or on what full onboarding involves (account setup, cards, transfers). Missing for 10: documented end-to-end onboarding timeline including verification/approval, detail on what 'fully onboarded' covers, independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can fully onboard onto a new banking platform in about a week instead of months
